Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single transparent spaceship sprite for StarChain, enemy tier 1 "星针探测器", landscape 1536x1024 preferred.
Primary request: Generate ONE very small and simple autonomous space probe, with a distinctly compact spherical-to-teardrop hull and exactly three short sensor fins arranged radially. This is visibly the weakest, lowest tier reconnaissance probe in a spaceship progression. The front faces LEFT and the stern faces RIGHT. At its LEFT-front is one modest blue-violet optical core. At its RIGHT-rear is ONE small recessed aft thruster with a short subdued violet exhaust. Only a few silver segmented armor plates cover black internal machinery. No cockpit, no pilot, no humanoid head, no arms or legs. It must look like a spacecraft probe, not a large fighter.
Input role: supplied image is ONLY a reference for realistic silver plate materials, black machinery, purple/cyan detail lights, surface rendering and studio lighting. Do NOT reproduce the reference ship shape, pointed fighter nose, massive wings, multiple engines, complexity or size.
Composition: isolated complete body, horizontal left-facing three-quarter view seen slightly from above, centered; 8 percent clear margin around every outer part, no crop. Clear small rounded silhouette, compact length relative to height, subtle asymmetry from camera perspective. Three stubby sensor fins only, not large fighter wings. Single optical lens serves as the leftmost identifiable front. Single aft engine sits at the rightmost end.
Style: cinematic realistic hard-surface spacecraft render, fine restrained mechanical detail, believable assembled silver armor plates, black recessed joints, a few worn edges, cool white top-left key light and gentle violet rim glow. Matches reference realism and lighting. Distinct silhouette from the reference.
Background: genuinely transparent RGBA, clean alpha edges around body and small emission plume.
Avoid: background of any kind, opaque black backdrop, ground plane, cast shadow, ambient fog halo, text, letters, numbers, watermark, UI, beams, laser firing, weapons, long exhaust trails, humans, humanoid robots, sea or land vehicles, huge wings, large fighter silhouette, dual engines, multiple ships.
